safe_interpretation: Freshness-priority RL approaches the freshness of Always-Transmit while improving lifetime; it is not claimed to beat Always-Transmit on AoI alone.
Energy-priority RL approaches conservative-policy lifetime while preserving fresher information than sleep-only behaviour; it is not claimed to beat the sleep-only lifetime extreme.
Balanced RL is interpreted using a combined AoI–lifetime trade-off cost against practical heuristics, not against one-objective extremes.
